_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Charles Timothy Brooks (1813-1883): Goethe's Faust, Part I (1856), and Jean Paul's Titan, Hesperus and The Invisible Lodge (Holt, 1862-83). His Wilhelm Busch is on the other lane's wilhelm-busch shelf. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 23); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

Both archive.org scans (schillershomageo00broouoft, schillershomageo00broo) garble his name on the title page ('CHARLES T.' BROOKS', 'CHARLES TV BROOKS'), so they fail the identity gate. Left off 2026-10-23 (round 141), like other gate failures.
